engine: Saisei's signature primitive — a vertical centre seam that OPENS (a fill splits from the centre line outward, revealing what's behind) or CLOSES (two halves slide from the edges to a centre seam, covering what's behind). ONE engine, four uses across Saisei: the homepage preloader (black splits from centre), the page-enter (cream curtain splits to reveal the dark page), the menu-close inverse (cream converges to centre), and a focal-image reveal (a portrait opens through an expanding centre slit). Harvested from D_saisei (S1).

measured_teardown.move: OPEN: a full cover is peeled apart from the centre line outward via clip-path inset (inset(0) full cover -> inset(0 50% 0 50%) gone) so the layer behind is revealed centre->edges. CLOSE: the inverse — the cover grows from the edges inward to a hairline centre seam, covering the layer behind. The 'expensive' tell is the TWO-PHASE COLOUR: a page transition CLOSES in cream (brand bg) then re-OPENS in dark, so the seam 'breathes light, exhales dark'.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei preloader: black seam widens centre->edges over a cream curtain (frames p016 hairline -> p020 fat -> p024 ~60% -> p028 full black). Page transition v2 f064-071 cream converges (close), v3 f053-062 dark opens centre->edges (open). Same geometry at four scales.

fill.what: the cover colour. Cream (#f0e9d2) to CLOSE a page in the brand bg; dark to OPEN/reveal a dark page. Two-phase = close cream then open dark.

duration.what: open duration (close uses the same unless overridden).

ease.what: open easing (fast start, long soft tail = Saisei reveal).

z.what: z-index of the injected cover over the target.

entry: CenterSeamSplit.create(target, opts) -> { el, open(o), close(o), set(p), progress, destroy }. target = element/selector or null (=body, fixed full-viewport). It injects a .css-cover over the target and drives its clip-path. open() peels the seam centre->edges (reveal behind). close() grows edges->centre (cover). set(p): 0 = fully covering, 1 = fully open — PURE, drive from a scrub if wanted. close({fill}) re-tints for the close phase.
law: clip-path inset + opacity only on the injected cover; GPU layer (will-change:clip-path); NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant state (no tween). Built-in rAF tween when GSAP absent (GSAP used if present). For a page transition: close(cream) -> hold (monogram-ring-loader sits here) -> open(dark). owns_pin false (it's a timeline/triggered cover, not a scroll owner).
gate_mode: the cover is a clip-path div, not an , and the transition is triggered (not scroll-driven) — the smoothness-gate (which drives wheel-scroll and looks for media) does not apply. Verify with a direct rAF-pacing probe over the real close->open run: cover present every frame, clip-path animates, fps>=50, jank<8%.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO hero behind a Saisei-style transition — cream page CLOSES in cream (seam converges edges->centre, power3.inOut 0.55s), brief hold, then dark cover OPENS (seam splits centre->edges, expo.out 0.85s) revealing the QUADRO hero through the widening slit (matches Saisei preloader p024: hero through centre, dark margins). insetFor('x',0.5)=inset(0 25% 0 25%) verified; two-phase colour cream#f0e9d2->dark#0e0e0c verified. Direct rAF probe (built-in tween, no gsap, 4x CPU throttle): 0/105 long frames (0.0%), 59.9fps, worst 18ms, cover present every frame.
